benchmark_pairs.rationale: Same title appears under two OAK registration IDs; duplicate alert expected.
Both combine AI and journalist activity; ethics vs comparative creativity/subjectivity.
AI + journalism/media overlap; audience trust and multimedia integration differentiate the second.
Both concern online media, but research problems differ.
Both PR communication; crisis management vs ethical-professional principles.
Lexical trap: AI/social media/text analysis does not mean same discipline or research problem.
Lexical trap: 'video' in computer vision is not audiovisual journalism.
Online/interactivity concepts overlap, but domains and objectives differ.
Management/digital overlap, but pedagogy competence vs industrial HR optimization.
Monitoring/information-system vocabulary should not create false media-domain similarity.
Both engineering/modeling, but physical objects differ; tests domain-aware similarity.
